description: Create a QR code (a short link). With target_url it is a link code to that URL (Wi-Fi page, reviews, Instagram, a campaign). Without target_url it is another menu code — a separate placement (e.g. "Window") with its own scan count; the menu already has a default code, so only add one when the owner wants to tell placements apart. Table codes are made by create_tables. Print it with export_qr_codes(purpose: link, shortlink_ids: [code]).

label.description: What it is or where it goes, e.g. "Window"

target_url.description: http(s) URL; omit for a menu code

name: create_qr_code
title: Create qr code
